title: Addressing the FHIR modeller
description: How to write for a reader acting as FHIR modeller. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

rules.title: Specification register
rules.description: Specification register. Cardinalities, invariants, must-support. Assume the standard is known.

source.quote: Builds the L3 profiles. Fluent in FHIR and in the tooling; wants the model's constraints and invariants, not an introduction to the resource.
